_comment: CourtListener v4 citation-lookup endpoint. POSTs {"text": "<query>"} and takes element[0] of the returned array. Rate limits depend on auth state: when COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN is set, the adapter uses the citation-lookup authenticated tier directly (60/min, no docs-page fetch). When no token is set, the adapter bootstraps from rate_limits_docs_url and falls back to rate_limits_anonymous if the fetch fails.
